title: Designing sustainable barn-type houses: Optimal shapes for minimal envelope and energy use
summary: Barn-type houses have become one of the most popular single-family housing typologies in Poland and across Europe due to their simplicity, functionality, and potential for energy efficiency. Despite their widespread use, systematic methods for optimizing their geometry in terms of envelope area and energy performance remain limited. This paper develops a rigorous mathematical framework for determining the optimal proportions of barn-type houses with respect to minimizing the external surface area while satisfying constraints of either fixed volume or fixed floor area.
